PostgreSQL 18 Released!

www.postgresql.org/about/news/postgresql-18-released-3142/     2025-09-25T00:00:00.0000000
A key PostgreSQL feature is the generation and storage of statistics that help PostgreSQL select the most efficient query plan. Before PostgreSQL 18, these statistics didn't carry over on a major version upgrade, which could cause significant query performance degradations on busy systems until the ANALYZE finished running.
